blurb: Banyan Charters offers private boat tours with smooth riding boats featuring comfortable seating, sun and shade options, reclining lounge seats, freshwater wash down, sun-pad, high end stereo, and wrap around midship windshield. Guests enjoy quality time with family and friends while exploring the waters around Marco Island. The company emphasizes creating lifelong memories through bonding and enjoying nature.
